description:
**Title**: Climate Risk Data Science Intern

**Available** now full-time, might be able to start part-time until May 2026

**Location: Singapore**

EDHEC Climate Institute is looking for a motivated and technically strong Data Science Intern to support the development of our infrastructure ratings. The successful candidate will collaborate closely with senior team members on real-world data science problems.

The production of climate risk ratings relies on:

· Sophisticated climate risk models complemented by robust analytics

· A structured, production-grade codebase supporting model simulations and the generation of ratings

The code structure must be designed with reliability, efficiency, and maintainability as core principles. The successful candidate will help improve existing code and structures, and assist in developing new ones. This requires strong coding and organizational skills.

This internship is a great opportunity to work at the interface of climate science, finance, and regulation, while developing strong analytical and coding skills.

Moreover, this internship is a potential pathway to a full-time Junior Data Scientist position, subject to performance.

**Duration: 6 months**

**Key Responsibilities**

· Assist in improving the maintainability, efficiency, and robustness of the codebase

· Assist in building and maintaining data pipelines

· Develop analytical tools to improve the traceability of results

· Support data analysis, modeling, and data processing tasks

· Produce clean, well-structured, and well-documented code

· Contribute to the documentation of methods and workflows

Required Skills & Qualifications

· Strong general programming skills, with a focus on logic, readability, efficiency, automation, and maintainability

· Solid proficiency in Python, ideally with experience in object-oriented Python

· Familiarity with common Python libraries for data science (e.g. pandas, numpy)

· Experience with collaborative version-control tools (Git)

· Meticulous and analytical mindset, with a strong interest in problem-solving

· Ability to work independently under minimal supervision

· At least a bachelor’s degree in a technical curriculum such as computer science, finance, economics, or physics

**Nice to Have**

· Proven experience with data science projects

· A master’s degree in a technical curriculum

· Basic knowledge of financial concepts and modelling

· Interest in climate change–related topics

**Profile We Are Looking For - Please read carefully**

You are rigorous and enjoy solving concrete problems with data. You care deeply about code quality and take pride in improving your code’s readability and efficiency.

You are curious and keen to expand your knowledge in climate finance.

You want to grow as a professional data scientist, and see this internship as a solid stepping-stone towards that objective.

We value clean, production-ready code as much as correct results.

**Interested?** Apply now by sending your resume (**pdf format**) and a brief statement of interest.

*Please note: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. If you do not hear from us within 21 days, please assume your application has not been successful on this occasion.*

**About Grab and Our Workplace**

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. In Grab, purpose gives us joy and habits build excellence, while harnessing the power of Technology and AI to deliver the mission of driving Southeast Asia forward by economically empowering everyone, with heart, hunger, honour, and humility.

The Group Sustainability Team leads ESG at the Group level, covering Grab's various entities and operating markets. We work cross-functionally to embed sustainability into operations, governance, and disclosures — supporting resilient, responsible growth.

**Get to Know the Role**

You will lead the production of our annual ESG disclosures and public sustainability reports, ensuring all data is accurate, audit-ready, and aligned with IFRS S1/S2 and GRI standards. You will coordinate submissions to ESG rating agencies and manage responses to external auditors and investor inquiries. You will also identify and implement digital tools to automate data collection and validation processes, working with Finance, Legal, and business units to ensure consistent data methodologies across the organization.

This is a fully onsite role and will report to the Head of Group Sustainability.

**The Critical Tasks You Will Perform**

* **Report Production:** Lead the end-to-end writing, data aggregation, and high-fidelity production of public ESG disclosures, ensuring a compelling narrative and consistency in Annual Report and ESG Disclosures.
* **Audit & Assurance Readiness:** Establish robust internal controls, data governance frameworks, and comprehensive documentation to prepare disclosures for assurance by third-party auditors.
* **Integrated Risk Execution:** Implement and manage Double Materiality and Climate Scenario Analysis (IFRS S2) workflows to map and quantify the financial implications of ESG risks for management review and strategic planning.
* **ESG Rating Strategy:** Proactively manage the lifecycle of ESG Ratings and Benchmarks (e.g., MSCI, Sustainalytics, CDP); ensuring accurate data representation and identifying strategic levers to optimize Grab’s sustainability profile.

**Tech and AI for ESG Enablement:** Lead the identification and implementation of digital tools and workflows; from automating data and ensuring auditability to drivin

 **Qualifications**

**What Essential Skills You Will Need**

* 3+ years of experience producing ESG disclosures aligned with IFRS S1/S2 and GRI standards, demonstrated through prior work on annual sustainability reports or integrated reports for public companies.
* Knowledge of audit processes and internal control frameworks for non-financial data, gained from managing at least one third-party assurance engagement for ESG disclosures.
* Familiarity with ESG rating agency platforms (MSCI, Sustainalytics, CDP) and experience managing annual submission timelines and responding to investor inquiries.
* Experience implementing digital tools or software solutions for data automation in a reporting or analytics context, with working knowledge of data visualization tools such as Tableau or Power BI.
* Project Management & Cross-Functional Coordination: Strong demonstrable ability to structure workstreams, align diverse stakeholders, and deliver complex ESG initiatives accurately and on schedule.

* We have a confidential **Grabber Assistance Programme** to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
* Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

**What We Stand For at Grab**

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.
